synthetic_chat_specificity.description: Recovery of genuinely fine-tuned-specific structure among shared, strength-asymmetric and partially separated concepts.
synthetic_chat_specificity.notes: Scaled synthetic setting: 64-d paired streams, 112 concepts, 512 factors, mean L0 <= 6.6, 65,536 training and 524,288 evaluation inputs. These results are measured gym reference runs, refreshed by hardening/final_audit.py. Original Gemma paper numbers are preserved unchanged under underscore-prefixed metadata and are not comparison targets. Fixed-size discovery uses measured model presence and ground-truth specificity; decoder-norm and residual Latent Scaling classifications are separate unscored diagnostics.

false_ft_only_rate.description: False discovery fraction of measured chat-contribution mass among 32 factors with lowest measured base/chat presence. Ground-truth alignment and conditional presence determine correctness. Duplicate claims on one target receive no extra credit. Empty discovery has value 1.

chat_specific_recall.description: Fraction of 32 fine-tuned-specific target structures recovered by the fixed 32 selected factors; genuinely specific requires cosine >= 0.8 and activity-weighted ground-truth base/chat ratio < 0.2.

reconstruction_fve.description: Evaluator-computed fraction of joint activation variance explained. Each stream must also have FVE >= 0.60; recall >= 0.10 and fixed capacity/sparsity constraints must hold in both experiments, or every scored metric receives its worst value.

_paper_reported.source: Table 1 (Gemma2-2B-Chat rows), Table 4, Tables 2-3 (validation, final epoch)
